newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Home & Garden sees higher FY97 revs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Home & Garden sees higher FY97 revs.

text.p: U.S. Home & Garden Inc said Friday it expects sales for its fiscal year 1997, ending June 30, to rise to about $50 million from $27 million in fiscal 1996.
The company said it sees "significant growth from our landscape edging and shade fabric lines along with the remainder of our product lines."
It said it will continue to add synergistic businesses and product lines through acquisition.

U.S. Home & Garden today reported fiscal 1996 earnings of $0.25 a share, up from $0.19 a year ago. It said the increase was due primarily to growth at its Easy Gardener subsidiary, a supplier of consumer landscape fabrics, shade cloth and landscape edging to mass merchandisers and home centers nationwide.
